yugoo-app-builder 1.0.0

- Initial release of the yugoo-app-builder skill for building full-stack web applications via the 语构 chat-driven platform.
- Enables app creation, iteration, publishing, deployment, and version management through CLI commands, not direct API calls.
- Requires the CREO4U_SKILL_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Includes clear guidelines for app description, complexity limits (max 1–2 features/bugs per request), and iterative development best practices.
- Provides routing keywords and example requests for appropriate usage scenarios.
- Stateles execution: relies on conversation and message IDs for workflow continuity.
